title: The Murder Floating in the Water Stream Restaurant
notes: Recurring detective-cast (Conan, Kogoro, Ran, Inspector Megure, Officer Takagi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: actions are direct typed edges. Unlike other episodes in this batch, this transcript gives no red-herring motive material for the second suspect (Arai) -- he has a clean, corroborated alibi (a timestamped convenience-store receipt) and no stated grudge against the victim beyond mild annoyance at his attitude, so per the honesty rule no has_motive_against edge is fabricated for him; only the culprit carries a motive edge here. case_type: murder.

attrs.alibi: sent by Iwama to buy a specific cigarette brand not sold at the restaurant register; a convenience-store receipt timestamped 7:52 PM, minutes after the estimated time of death, cleared him

attrs.past_misconduct: years earlier, put his own name on a student's thesis paper and passed it off as his own work

persons.name: Keizo Kaneda
persons.occupation: assistant professor of physics, Jomon University (newly promoted the day of the murder)

attrs.died_of: stabbed through the heart with a dagger, died instantly
attrs.died_where: Room 8, having been lured there under the pretense of a private conversation

attrs.note: first to discover the body; confirmed the front door and bridge were the only way in on foot, and that she held the only room key -- ruling out an ordinary walk-in killer and pointing investigators toward the waterway

attrs.significance: crime scene; found completely dry, ruling out anyone swimming in through the shallow (~50cm) waterway
Iwama and Arai's private room; staged with a rigged door and a tape recorder to fake Iwama's continuous presence

attrs.mechanism: big enough for a person to hide in after removing the serving boards and food; equipped with a small motor and a sensor that automatically returns it to the dock, which the culprit disabled and re-enabled with his foot to redirect it to Room 8 and back
attrs.staging_flaw: the boat's waterline was unusually high for the small whiskey-and-ice order it carried on its return trip, proving it had been carrying a hidden passenger's weight

attrs.used_for: played pre-recorded sounds (dishes clattering, a search for a dropped contact lens) from Room 3 to simulate his continued presence while he was actually in Room 8

objects.name: Rubber band, pin, chopstick wrapper and ice (door-closing rig)

attrs.mechanism: a rubber band pinned between the sliding door and its frame was held open by a paper chopstick wrapper pinned in place; ice set on the wrapper slowly melted, softened the paper until it tore, and let the rubber band snap the door shut on its own, timed to look like Iwama closing it himself
attrs.staging_flaw: a tiny pinhole and a leftover wet spot on the door frame in Room 3 survived Iwama's attempt to dispose of the rig, and gave the trick away

objects.name: Blowfish-milt sauce stain on Iwama's shirt/jacket

attrs.significance: Kaneda had sauce on his thumb from spilled blowfish milt before he ever reached Room 8; the same sauce was found on Iwama's shirt where the jacket covered it, with Kaneda's fingerprints in it, from grabbing his attacker during the struggle
attrs.cover_story: Iwama falsely claimed the stain came from spilling sauce himself while searching for a dropped contact lens

attrs.timestamp: 7:52 PM, just after the 7:50 PM estimated time of death
attrs.significance: corroborated Arai's alibi and confirmed Iwama had deliberately sent him on an errand timed to keep him away during the murder

clues.desc: Waterline clue: the returning serving boat carried only a small whiskey-and-ice order, yet sat unusually low in the water -- the waterline was consistent with a hidden adult passenger's weight, not the light order alone, proving someone had ridden the boat.

Sauce/fingerprint clue: sauce from the victim's own spilled blowfish-milt order was found both on his thumb and, with his fingerprints pressed into it, on the culprit's jacket where he claims he never touched sauce -- placing the victim's hand on the culprit's clothing at the time of the struggle.

Door-rig clue: a tiny pinhole and a leftover wet spot on the Room 3 door frame -- residue of the rubber-band-and-melting-ice mechanism used to snap the door shut unattended -- contradict the impression that Iwama closed the door himself while inside the whole time.

Jacket-composure clue: Iwama was seen putting his jacket on as he emerged to the scene after Anzai's scream -- an oddly composed, deliberate action for someone supposedly reacting to a sudden emergency, consistent with covering a stain he needed hidden rather than genuine surprise.

edges.detail: asked to speak with Kaneda privately and had him reserve Room 8 under his own name
asked for a specific cigarette brand not sold at the restaurant register, forcing a roughly 20-minute round trip to a convenience store
hid in the large serving boat after unloading its food, disabled the return sensor with his foot to divert it to Room 8

edges.method: stabbed through the heart with a dagger; the victim grabbed his attacker's jacket during the struggle, leaving sauce-stained fingerprints

edges.detail: turned the body to face the doorway so investigators would assume the killer entered on foot, not by the waterway
rode the boat back, re-enabled the sensor so it returned automatically to the dock, then re-entered Room 3 through the rigged door
attempted to remove the rubber band and pins and dispose of the wrapper, but a pinhole and wet spot remained in the door frame
cashier who went in to check on Kaneda after he entered Room 8 but never placed an order, and discovered the body

edges.motive_type: blackmail_and_reputation (Kaneda knew Iwama had once plagiarized a student's thesis and threatened to expose it unless Iwama recommended him for assistant professor and paid him 5,000,000 yen)
